headline: Image compressor hits exact KB size in-browser, no uploads
summary: Developer creates image compressor that works entirely in-browser
details: A developer has built an image compressor called SwiftShrink that works entirely in the browser, allowing users to compress images to an exact KB size without uploading their files.
The compressor uses a binary search over JPEG quality and a dimension-shrink fallback via the Canvas API, ensuring that the image never leaves the browser tab.
This approach allows for precise control over the compressed file size, making it useful for applications such as government forms, exams, or visa applications where image size limits are strict.
caption:
Can you compress an image to an exact KB size without uploading it?

A developer has built an image compressor called SwiftShrink that works entirely in the browser, allowing users to compress images to an exact KB size without uploading their files.

The compressor uses a binary search over JPEG quality and a dimension-shrink fallback via the Canvas API, ensuring that the image never leaves the browser tab.

This approach allows for precise control over the compressed file size, making it useful for applications such as government forms, exams, or visa applications where image size limits are strict.

headline_marked: Roelof Botha joins [[SpaceX's board of directors]]
headline: Roelof Botha joins SpaceX's board of directors
summary: Former Sequoia Capital managing partner joins SpaceX board
details: Roelof Botha, former managing partner at Sequoia Capital, has joined SpaceX's board of directors. This appointment comes less than a week after SpaceX went public in its record-breaking IPO.
Botha was appointed to fill an existing vacancy on the board and will serve until SpaceX's next annual shareholder meeting. He will also join the company's audit committee.

Botha brings extensive experience with public companies and audit committees, having served on numerous boards. He has a history with SpaceX investor Elon Musk, having worked under him at PayPal in 2000.
The addition of Botha brings SpaceX's board to nine directors, including Musk, Gwynne Shotwell, and other prominent figures in tech and finance.
